front: Make minor cosmetic changes to your look or a small effect around you, like hair color, cosmetics, lighting or a chime.
back:
Alter a minor detail of your appearance or create a small environmental effect confined to your person. Sustain to make further adjustments; changes last for the duration (1 hour).
At GM's discretion, may grant +1 status bonus to tasks such as Impersonate or Perform.
